clips.title: The story
paras: At the Hushed Bank, Sven Yorgen grieves his murdered family and seeks vengeance. He camps on the northern edge of the bank in western Duskwood with his companion Lars, determined to learn who ruined his home.

Sven Yorgen remembers Duskwood before Medivh's fall brought gloom to the region. Born before the First War, he spent years working the soil at the Yorgen Farmstead in southern Duskwood with his wife and children. Their quiet life ended when mysterious Dark Riders raided the homestead while Sven was away. They butchered his family and left the farm a graveyard.

Unable to return to his ruined home, Sven made a secluded refuge on the Hushed Bank with his friend Lars. He distrusts outsiders and asks travelers to prove their loyalty before he shares his burden. Near the devastated farmstead, Sven saw a figure skulking about. He became convinced the stranger was responsible for the massacre or connected to the sinister horsemen who destroyed his life.
